summary: The Backrooms is a survival RPG spanning authored maze levels, player-specific rooms and shared destinations such as the Bonus Room mall. `templates/player.js` composes player behaviors while scenes and place simulations supply authored environments and local systems; bespoke Blender pipelines build the Level 26 ship and the Level 2 modular tunnel kit.
places: places/bonus (3D) - shared vaporwave mall with shops, arcade, fountain, court storefronts and west-balcony lounge; authored shops plus shopper/staff simulation.
places/main (3D) - authored Level 0/Lobby maze; sim generates furniture/loot, safe-room almond water, shifting walls, creature ecology and versioned route-guidance moments.
places/intake (3D) + places/tutorial0 (solo ephemeral 3D) - bedroom character-creation/waking space and authored Level 0 tutorial route with staged encounter and HALOGEN.

places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Pipe Dreams and Locked; authored levels with local generation, loot and agents; Level 2 uses generated modelled tunnel modules over its retained collider shell.
places/level3, places/gamma, places/level4, places/level5 (3D) - Electrical Station, Base Gamma, Abandoned Office and Terror Hotel; residents, hazards, office/home systems and Boiler Room rats.
places/level6, places/level7, places/level10, places/level11 (3D) - later authored/generated levels including city, farm and venues; Level 10's fun poster routes to Level 26.

places/level26 (3D) - SS Fun =), Adventure liner lost in green fog; scene now places bespoke modeled hull and cabin meshes alongside bridge, funnel, deck, pool, wrecked bar/restaurant, Partygoers and balloons.

places/debug, places/spamton, places/level2, places/level21 and remaining configured places - auxiliary debug/fight spaces and the continuing Backrooms routes; all places use 3D mode except tutorial0's solo ephemeral instance.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, player/camera setup and ordered behavior composition; L maps to kick and Z to grab.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - place settings, authored placements and local generated/ticked behavior; places/main/sim.js owns Level 0 generation and timers.
sim.js - world cadence and out-of-bounds recovery.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js - title/pause, character creation, arrival, tutorial routing and first-arrival Level 26 cutscene driver.
places/intake/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/intake-geo.js + scripts/lib/intro-cut.js - bedroom shell and waking sequence; tutorial scene plus tut0 geometry/sim scripts own its route and beats.
scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - camera and third-person toggle; scripts/ui.js and specialized UI scripts present HUD, panels and cutscenes.
art/l26-ship/build.py + hull.py + super.py + lib.py + tex.py - Blender source pipeline exporting the Level 26 liner hull and superstructure GLBs and generating ship textures.
art/level2/build.py + compact.py + encode.py + pack.py - offline Level 2 kit geometry/data compaction and packing pipeline for the runtime kit decoder.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js - shared/solo room IDs, Bonus Room and home destinations/crossings; used by routing and hub handlers.
scripts/lib/loot.js + items.js + level data - common loot spawning, container rolls, remains and place pools; gates found weapon rarity by level.
scripts/lib/weapons.js + weapons.yml - weapon definitions, variants and rarity tiers reused by loot and combat.
scripts/lib/build-piece.js + breakables.yml + furniture.yml - canonical build specs/models shared by B-mode and home reconstruction.
scripts/lib/screen.js - derived read-only panel classifier and wrist gates shared by player, stats, craft, rest and menu input.
scripts/lib/maze.js and scripts/lib/level*.js + level data - grids, zones, layouts and paths reused by place sims, geometry and navigation.
scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml + critter.yml + hair.yml + scripts/lib/critter-model.js - wardrobe/look rules and player/NPC critter models.

scripts/lib/l2kit.js - Level 2 model-instance drawing/decoding from scripts/lib/l2kit-data, used by scripts/l2kit/*-geo.js; scripts/lib/knock.js - shared kicked/thrown-body recovery used by enemy managers.
notableExports: scripts/lib/loot.js - POOL, poolOf, rollWeapon, gateItems, rollItem, spawnCrate, rollLoot and level-specific loot helpers.
scripts/lib/weapons.js - rarityIdx, rarityCap; weapon registry default export.
scripts/grab.js - setDown, onInput, update; prop carrying and NPC/enemy pickup, hold, drop or throw. scripts/kick.js - onInput, kickEnd, update; wheeled-object shove and foe kick.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, useSnack, onInput, hitTarget and fishing handlers.
scripts/lib/screen.js - WRIST, screen, canOpen, openWrist; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom.
sim.js - cadence, tick, onOutOfBounds; places/main/sim.js and places/bonus/sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/partygoers.js - update; manager for tagged Partygoers and Carnivorous Balloons on Level 26. scripts/lib/knock.js - knocked, foeStats.
scripts/lib/l2kit.js - placements, kit, PARTS, spawnKit; scripts/l2kit/{ceil,corner,duct,floor,floordrain,lamp,pier,piperun,tray,wall}-geo.js - geometry and collider module exports.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, money, appearance, combat/rewards and level access; found snacks/aid are state inventory.
scripts/kick.js - per-player session kicked-chair rolls and push sound cooldown; foe kicks write transient target state.down/state.kb and stunUntil.
scripts/lib/knock.js - shared physics/timing recovery for down/kb and thrown/overboard records; enemy managers retain their own AI state and pause it while held or recovering.
scripts/lurkers.js - player.state.lurkHold while caught and lurker entity grab/frenzy/prey state; release clears the player's hold.
scripts/build.js - active B-mode selection/ghost/session and placed build pieces; homeKeep.built persists home builds reconstructed by home sim.
scripts/hub.js - local mall offer/shop/food and room-hop flags; purchases update player currencies/unlocks and mall-local held food.

scripts/grab.js - carried prop/body IDs, held-body grip and throw session fields, carryMul, load/strength checks and player carry animation; target body state.heldBy/down controls its hold and release.

scripts/partygoers.js - Level 26 AI state (pack hunting, berserk hatch cycles, lunge/dodge/barrage/combo timing, stun/gait and balloon bob/gas); scripts/player.js owns player.state.stungUntil movement lock.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered behaviors: locomotion/player, swim, interact/grab/kick/rest/mahjong/talk/build/noclip/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/spamton-fight/horde/critter/main-menu/hub/view3.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.
scripts/routing.js accepts permitted requested rooms; otherwise scripts/lib/hub.js soloRoom selects player's solo Backrooms room and bonus overflow IDs.
Fresh visit → scripts/main-menu.js; START enters intake for creation or bonus for completed characters; wardrobe close runs intro-cut then tutorial0 unless t0Done.
scripts/lib/hub.js toHub/toSolo → room/place crossings; roomHop distinguishes intentional crossings from launch/resume.
Death recovery → scripts/hub.js hubOffer → hub-ui.js; local mall counters write hubShop → hub handler and hub-ui menus; purchases debit cents and grant configured stock.
Found loot search → scripts/interact.js calls loot.gateItems for non-storage/non-NPC contents; weapon rarity cap is level 1-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10+ elite.
Pickup weapon/food/aid → scripts/player.js inventory; SNACKS entries enter player.state.snacks for later Aid-panel use, with medical aid healing through healMed.

L input → scripts/kick.js onInput; pushes wheeled objects or kicks nearby foes, writing down/kb/stunUntil; target managers call scripts/lib/knock.js knocked() before AI to resolve kick/throw recovery.

Z input → scripts/grab.js onInput; picks a reachable eligible body if the player has hands free and sufficient strength, writes target heldBy/down and player carry session; Z tap drops or hold throws it, and enemy managers respect heldBy.

Melee player.js hitTarget and scripts/lib/ballistics.js bullet target queries include l8-hostile (excluding already-covered l8spider for melee), so tagged hostile entities are hittable by swings and shots.

Level 2 places/level2/sim.js → scripts/lib/l2kit.js spawnKit and per-part scripts/l2kit/*-geo.js visuals; breakables.syncWalls updates wall cuts while scripts/level2-geo.js retains the full original collider shell.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/lib/data/bonus.yml + places/bonus/sim.js - authored mall shops/landmarks with data-driven stock; sim adds staff, waypoint shoppers and balcony loungers.
scripts/mall-shopper.js + places/bonus/sim.js - shared stroll/stop/animation behavior across shopper critters; route state varies waypoints and pauses.
scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/build.js + places/home11/sim.js - per-piece models/dimensions with common placement, persistence and rebuild path.
places/main/cells/* and places/level5/cells/* - authored fixtures with local sound/light and zone variants; Level 5 includes portal/quest props and Boiler Room Death Rat packs.
places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + Level 4 geometry/detail/prop/look and l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js - office layout and fixtures with resident schedules/home claims.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - per-NPC role/dialogue/look/routine on shared meg-agent behavior.

scripts/lib/clothes.js + scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter.yml/hair.yml + art/critter-hair/build.py - player and NPCs share body/head/hair rendering; style meshes vary in form, with long backs, face-framing locks, multi-lock tails and braids.

art/level2/{build,compact,encode,pack}.py + scripts/lib/l2kit-data/* + scripts/lib/l2kit.js - authored module meshes become runtime geometry; compact.py decimates selected heavy parts, encode.py packs data and pack.py can emit 16-bit PNG sample streams.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - exports procedural balloon geometry/skeleton/collider but has no references; Level 26 scene placements and the barrage use uploaded models instead.
migrationNotes: Bonus Room uses shared room/place bonus; soloRoom(userId) names each player's Backrooms room and overflow mall rooms use bonus-N IDs. Keep routing and hub identity aligned.
Found-item rarity gates apply only to found weapon tokens; ownership/use of existing weapons and non-weapon loot is not level-gated. Search gating excludes storage and NPC containers.
Level 0 place.state.momentsV is 4: its migration deletes old tagged moment entities before relaying them; preserve deterministic route/arrow direction logic when changing moment layout.
At sanity <= 0 health is not drained; scripts/lib/stats.js lowers derived attributes except Luck by 2 (minimum 1), and derived values feed combat, carry and movement.

scripts/lib/knock.js consumes transient down/kb records and thrown-body flight/overboard state; all enemy managers that own these targets need to call knocked() before AI, and heldBy bodies must be excluded from ordinary AI.

Level 2's modelled kit is visual only: scripts/level2-geo.js retains the original full collider shell; keep kit visuals, seeded scripts/lib/level2.js layout and breakables.syncWalls cut handling aligned. Level 26's visible hull and cabins are exported meshes while hidden primitive geometry remains as proxy/collision structure; keep scene placements aligned with the mesh origins/offsets.
